properties.name: Fyodorov north
properties.note: Outline traced by eye on satellite imagery, not a surveyed boundary. Land use for 2019 and 2023 was declared as fallow because the satellite curve alone cannot tell weedy fallow from a failed crop.

properties.name: Shortandy west
properties.note: Outline traced by eye on satellite imagery, not a surveyed boundary. Land use was declared as fallow for 2021 and as crop for 2023 because the satellite curve alone cannot tell a failed crop from a weedy fallow.
